summary: Validated the FastAPI reverse-proxy Set-Cookie fix on port 8001. Through the PUBLIC preview URL, POST /api/auth/logout now returns THREE distinct Set-Cookie headers (session_token, session_token Partitioned, gachard_uid) as separate values — no longer collapsed by the proxy. Backend pytest: 8/8 passing including a new dedicated TestProxyCookieFix regression test. Frontend Playwright (5/5): (1) /login shows 'Continue with Google', (2) unauthenticated /profile → /login (middleware gating works), (3) with seeded session_token + gachard_uid cookies + localStorage.user, /profile renders (profile-page + profile-username='@QAUser' + profile-balance visible) — the original bug 'not load into profile page' is FIXED, (4) /collection also renders when authenticated, (5) 'Continue with Google' click navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin>/auth-callback.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py proxy correctly uses upstream.headers.multi_items() + response.raw_headers to preserve duplicate Set-Cookie headers. Consider adding an integration test in the repo CI to prevent regression if anyone reverts to dict-based header forwarding.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral Mongo users/sessions seeded per test (qa.test.<ts>@example.com, test_session_<ts>) and deleted in teardown.
test_credentials: No real credentials; Mongo-seeded sessions per /app/auth_testing.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now includes TestProxyCookieFix::test_logout_returns_both_set_cookies_through_proxy which reads r.raw.headers.getlist('set-cookie') to assert BOTH session_token and gachard_uid arrive as separate headers through the port-8001 FastAPI proxy — the specific regression the developer fixed. All previously-flagged issues from iteration_13 are now resolved.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: after successful Google login, users were bounced from /profile to /login. Root cause was in backend/server.py which forwarded response headers via a dict, collapsing duplicate Set-Cookie entries and dropping the non-httpOnly gachard_uid cookie. Middleware then saw no gachard_uid and redirected /profile → /login. Fix (verified): proxy now iterates upstream.headers.multi_items() and sets response.raw_headers, preserving each Set-Cookie individually. curl -I on the public logout endpoint confirms 3 separate set-cookie lines (2 for session_token incl. Partitioned + 1 for gachard_uid).
